bull.b: Although LUGANO’s full-dataset primary endpoint was not met, its treatment-burden reduction, sustained anatomic control and favorable repeat-dose safety support a potentially differentiated long-acting therapy if follow-on data and regulatory review succeed.

Rapid completion of both pivotal DME trials reduces execution uncertainty and preserves a path to topline data in Q4 2027. Successful results could expand DURAVYU into a large retinal market and strengthen EyePoint’s long-term competitive position.

Stated liquidity through Q4 2027 and an operating cGMP facility provide support for pivotal development, CMC work and potential commercialization. This infrastructure gives EyePoint time to reach major milestones without immediate debt pressure.

bear.b: Failure on the prespecified primary endpoint materially raises regulatory and commercialization risk for DURAVYU in wet AMD. Secondary benefits may help, but the result weakens confidence in approval timing, label breadth and market adoption.

bear.t: Severe Cash Burn and Revenue Decline
bear.b: The combination of collapsing revenue, widening losses and substantial cash outflows creates sustained financing and runway risk. Even with reported liquidity into Q4 2027, continued development and commercialization may require additional capital.

The settlement resolves legacy exposure but adds five years of oversight, training, board review and compliance obligations. These requirements can increase operating costs, constrain commercial practices and keep regulatory scrutiny elevated.
